scope: Combined production MotoGP R2 BikeHud and Interface with synthetic telemetry and actual Saira fonts. Four individually inspected component images; no rendered game world.
method: Every listed full PNG was individually opened with view_image after its passing combined-build test. No composite-only or filename-only review.

images.observed: Desktop GP-R1 panel is anchored above the vehicle controls with gear 4, 162 km/h, 11340 RPM, 12.4 kg fuel, L 46 degrees lean, 35% rear pedal and separate front/rear tyre values. Classification, timing and minimap remain clear; the car battery dial is absent.

Compact landscape uses the MOTOBOUND top bar and a narrower lower-right bike panel. Speed, gear, RPM, fuel, lean, rear pedal and both tyre temperatures fit within its edges without horizontal clipping.

Portrait keeps the bike readout above touch controls; 162 km/h, gear 4, RPM, fuel and both tyre channels remain visible. The bottom monospace fixture stamp identifies synthetic telemetry and is not production UI.
The RIDER MFD sits to the left of the GP readout with a visible gap. Chassis lean, hang-off, tuck, traction/wheelie control and fork/shock compression are legible; the panels do not overlap.
